aggregation_description: Index level, 2021=100. Summing or averaging across countries, breakdowns or months has no economic meaning; use the published aggregate (EA21) or the published rates of change.
Month-on-month % change. Rates neither add across countries nor chain by summing across months; recompute from index levels.
Year-on-year % change. Rates do not add across countries or months, and averaging them needs weights that are not in the model; use the published aggregate.
HICP annual rate of change. Country rates combine only with HICP country weights, which are not loaded; use the published euro area aggregate.
Unemployed as % of the labour force. Combining needs the unemployed and labour force counts, which are not loaded; use the published aggregate.
Net balance of positive minus negative survey answers. The euro area figure is a weighted aggregate of national surveys; use the published aggregate rather than averaging countries.

aggregation_short: Sum countries, never months or totals
aggregation_description: Thousand persons. Additive across countries and across non-overlapping breakdown categories, never across months, and never together with aggregates (EA, EU) or totals.

aggregation_short: Not additive, use the published level row
aggregation_description: Regionalstatistik count, published separately for districts, Länder and Germany and rounded at each level. Districts do not sum to the published Land or national figure; use the row published for the level.
